text:
matt: seeing weird truncation of outputs in prod after today's deploy — emojis getting replaced with � or cut mid-emoji, and hit an OOM when loading a quantized variant. rolling back?
anya: oh no. can you paste an example prompt + the actual output you saw? which model/variant and pool?
matt: Model: redwood/o3-small-quant-v2 (dedicated pool). Prompt: `Summarize: ❤️‍🔥 this tweet` -> Output: `Summarize: �` (emoji gone). also saw a loader OOM: `RuntimeError: cuda out of memory while initializing quant params` from serving-worker-12. attaching short log snippet.
cheng: we merged the tokenizer normalizer change earlier today (NFKC normalization). that can break grapheme cluster handling for multi-codepoint emoji. @sara did we run token-level diffs on canary?
sara: tokenizer rev `tokenizer@2026-03-16T22:10` (normalizer: true) was included. canary had small token diffs but emojis weren't in the smoke prompts. starting a focused canary with emoji-heavy prompts now.
matt: paste of log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T08:12:41Z] model_loader: loading quant shards for redwood/o3-small-quant-v2
[2026-03-17T08:12:43Z] shard 2/4 allocate 3280MB -> cuda OOM
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/serving/loader.py", line 212, in load_quant
    alloc_tensor(...)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. attempted to allocate 3276800000 bytes
```
also noticed kernel fallback to CPU for one op which caused a spike and GC.
ops-bot: Deploy rollback executed for service: serving-worker-prod by @dave at 1792004380
dave: rolled back to stable for now. next steps: we need a repro script that hits the emoji case + confirm whether the weights layout changed (symlink/shard layout) — @cheng can you link the tokenizer PR + check weight paths?
cheng: PR is https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/459 (tokenizer normalizer). quick check: quant weights symlink on some hosts still points to `shards_v1` while new layout is `shards_v2` — that can create different shard size distribution and trigger OOM on some GPUs. I'm opening infra PR to fix symlink resolution.
anya: if symlink mismatch causes larger contiguous allocs that explains the OOM variance across machines. mitigation: pin prod routing to the non-quant variant until we confirm fixed; route a small percentage to canary non-quant + updated tokenizer.
sara: will update routing: pin prod -> redwood/o3-small (non-quant) and route 5% traffic to canary with tokenizer-norm and corrected shard layout. deploying routing change in ~5m.
matt: adding minimal repro (python snippet) and raw logs to the issue.
dave: please include tokenized length, byte offsets, and grapheme cluster counts in the repro. if we have >2 incidents we schedule a quick postmortem. :thumbsup:
cheng: created issue IR-2026-33 with links to logs, repro, and PRs. assigning to eng-ml.
sara: canary started. early signs: emoji handling still differs token-by-token vs stable but no OOMs yet on canary hosts. will monitor p95.
anya: thanks all — let us know when the symlink fix and tokenizer revert/adjustment land so we can plan a controlled rollout back to quant.
matt: ack, will follow up in the issue with more examples. thanks everyone.
ops-bot: Note: incident ticket IR-2026-33 created and linked to paging log (severity: P2)"
